name: BuilderGlut – Page Builder, Templates Library, Blocks, Widgets for Block Editor and Elementor
author: AppGlut

sections.description:
BuilderGlut gives you one set of building parts for two editors. Use 106 blocks in the block editor, or the same parts as 110 widgets in Elementor. Start from a ready-made section or a whole website, or ask the AI builder to design one.

Blocks and widgets

  • 106 free blocks: layout (container, rows, columns, grid), headings, paragraphs, buttons, images, galleries, sliders, tabs, accordions, counters, countdowns, pricing tables, testimonials, team members, maps, forms, post grids and more.
  • 10 free WooCommerce blocks: product grid, categories, price, rating, add to cart, mini cart, tabs, related products and more.
  • The same parts as Elementor widgets, with a Style tab for colours, typography and alignment, plus site widgets such as Nav Menu, Site Logo, Site Title, Page Title, Post Title and Featured Image.
  • Switch any block or widget on or off from the BuilderGlut dashboard. Switched-off parts are not loaded.

Template library

  • 3,000+ free sections in 54 categories: heroes, headers, footers, call to action, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, team, contact, product grids, product pages, cart, checkout, account pages and more.
  • 83 free full websites, including many WooCommerce store designs. Import a website to create all its pages, or insert one page or one section into the page you are editing.
  • Every section and website has a full-size preview with next and previous buttons.
  • Everything is built from BuilderGlut’s own blocks and widgets, so you can edit it like any other content. Templates and pictures are loaded from appglut.com when you use them, so the plugin itself stays small.
  • My sections: save selected blocks and upload or download them as a file.

AI Builder

Describe a section or a whole page and BuilderGlut designs it for you, using its own blocks. Five sample commands are built in. Choose the AI service you like and add your own key: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Grok, Groq, Cohere, Perplexity, OpenRouter, Together AI, Fireworks, Cerebras, or an AI on your own computer (Ollama, LM Studio).

Works with the block editor, Elementor and WooCommerce. Elementor and WooCommerce are optional.

BuilderGlut Pro (a separate plugin) adds more blocks and widgets, advanced WooCommerce parts, and 2,700+ more sections and 83 more websites.

External services

BuilderGlut connects to outside services only for the features below.

Template library host
The template library downloads its templates and pictures from https://www.appglut.com/wp-content/uploads/builderglut-library/ (you can change the address). This happens when you open the template library, and when you insert or import a template. Only the request for the file is sent (your server’s address as in any web request). No personal data is sent. Provider: AppGlut, https://www.appglut.com.

AI Builder (optional)
If you use the AI Builder, your description of the design and the instructions for the design format are sent to the AI service you choose, together with the API key you saved. Nothing is sent until you press Generate. You can pick one of: Anthropic (https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy), OpenAI (https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy), Google Gemini (https://policies.google.com/privacy), Mistral AI (https://mistral.ai/terms/), DeepSeek (https://www.deepseek.com/privacy), xAI (https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy), Groq (https://groq.com/privacy-policy/), Cohere (https://cohere.com/privacy), Perplexity (https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/privacy-policy), OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/privacy), Together AI (https://www.together.ai/privacy), Fireworks AI (https://fireworks.ai/privacy-policy), Cerebras (https://www.cerebras.ai/privacy-policy), or an AI that runs on your own computer (Ollama, LM Studio), or another OpenAI compatible address that you enter. API keys are stored in your site’s database and are never sent to the browser.

Google Fonts and maps
Some templates load fonts from Google Fonts, and the Map block can load tiles from OpenStreetMap. These load in the visitor’s browser when a page uses them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate BuilderGlut.
  3. Open BuilderGlut in the admin menu, or edit any page and click Library in the editor toolbar.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor?

No. The blocks work in the block editor on their own. Install Elementor if you want the widgets.

Do the templates work without an internet connection?

No. Templates and pictures are loaded from appglut.com, so the plugin stays small. Pages you have already built keep working. When the library cannot be reached it shows a message and a Try again button, and it remembers what it has loaded for a few hours.

Do the templates use stock photos?

The store websites come with product photos (food, plants, furniture, gadgets and similar). They contain no people or animals. Replace any picture in the editor.

Where is my AI key stored?

In your site’s database, on your server only. It is never sent to the browser.

Can I turn off the blocks I do not use?

Yes. Open BuilderGlut > Blocks or Elementor Widgets and switch them off.

How do I import a whole website?

Open BuilderGlut > Templates > Websites, choose a design, press Preview to look at every page, then press Import all pages. Pages are created as drafts.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • New logo: the BuilderGlut mark is now a B made of blocks, in the plugin admin and the WordPress menu.

1.1.2

  • Fix: section previews in the template library are centred in their cards.
  • Change: sections are now grouped by type (Header, Hero, Pricing and so on) instead of by website category.
  • Change: the All / Free / Pro filter on the Websites tab sits beside the search box.
  • Fix: importing a website no longer uses a slow meta query to find its pages.
  • Change: plugin name now says “Block Editor” instead of the restricted term.

1.1.1

  • Fix: all blocks are now listed on the WordPress.org plugin page (block files moved to a blocks folder).
  • The old Container and Column blocks from version 1.0 are marked legacy and hidden from the inserter. Pages that use them keep working.

1.1.0

  • New: template library with 3,000+ free sections and 83 free full websites, built from BuilderGlut blocks and widgets.
  • New: full-size preview for every section and website, with next and previous buttons.
  • New: import a whole website as pages, for the block editor or Elementor.
  • New: My sections: save blocks and upload or download them as a file.
  • New: AI Builder with 16 AI services and five sample commands.
  • New: Elementor widgets for every block, with a Style tab, and site widgets (Nav Menu, Site Logo, Post Title and more).
  • New: admin dashboard to switch blocks and widgets on or off.
  • New: more typography and spacing options on the layout and text blocks.
  • New logo and plugin banner.

1.0.5

  • Earlier release: container and column blocks.
